transcript.content:
The bug is clear. In `modules/styles.py`, both `save_styles()` (line 212) and `get_style_paths()` (line 177) use `style_paths.remove("do_not_save")`. The `"do_not_save"` path is only added to the `style_paths` set when the styles file path contains a wildcard (`*`), which creates divider entries with `path="do_not_save"`. When there's no wildcard (the default case, using `styles.csv` directly), no divider entries exist, so `"do_not_save"` is never added to the set, and `remove()` raises a `KeyError`.

The fix is to use `set.discard()` instead of `set.remove()`, which safely removes an element only if present.
